exploit_name: Cross-chain operations fail due to LayerZero dust removal for ~69% of transaction amounts
description: Code sets minAmountLD equal to full amountLD. LayerZero's _removeDust() truncates amounts by dividing by conversion rates. When amounts contain dust (not divisible by 1e12), the dust-removed amount becomes less than minimum, triggering revert.
root_cause: Code sets minAmountLD equal to full amountLD. LayerZero's _removeDust() truncates amounts by dividing by conversion rates. When amounts contain dust (not divisible by 1e12), the dust-removed amount becomes less than minimum, triggering revert.
fix_description: Set minAmountLD to 0 or calculate the dust-removed amount: (assets / 1e12) * 1e12.
notes: Approximately 69% of real-world transaction amounts fail, leaving users unable to access funds.
